name: Miko
description: A self-hosted AI coding agent that takes tasks from your team tools, works in isolated Git worktrees, and reports progress back.
description_zh: 可自托管的 AI 编程助手。从团队协作工具接收任务，在独立的 Git 工作树中完成开发，并回报进度。

name: VidBee

description: Follow first-hand information across technology, AI, and developer communities with AI translation and summaries.

name: DayBee
description: A cross-platform microphone recorder with real-time transcription and voice activity detection.
description_zh: 跨平台麦克风录音工具，支持实时转写和语音活动检测。

name: VideoLingo
description: One-click AI subtitle cutting, translation, alignment, and dubbing.

name: Monitor Pro
description: Monitor the resources you care about, right inside Visual Studio Code.
description_zh: 直接在 Visual Studio Code 中监控你关心的系统资源。
